Brazilian jiu-jitsu and grappling. Come for self-defence, for competition, or to get in shape. You don't have to pick only one.
Coaches and the people who have been here longer will look after you, with manners and safety first.
A fundamentals class, and open mat
Help if you want to compete

Rash guards, no jacket. The rounds move faster.
Safety is part of the coaching
The coaching, and the rules for live rounds, are there to keep people training next week too.
From a first class to people who compete. You move when you are ready.
Different ages, different jobs, and a room that still trains together.
Clothes you can move in, with no zips or metal
A gi can be borrowed (replace this if it can't)
No-gi is a rash guard and shorts
Questions people ask before they join.
You can start unfit. The class meets you there.
You can borrow one for the intro. We'll point you to one after you join. Replace this if you do it differently.
The fundamentals class is built to keep the training safe.
Can women train here? What about older adults?
Yes. Women and older adults train here.
